name: Caught!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Hey! Hey, you! Get over here!

Ya gotta help me out. I was runnin' from them Dark Iron dwarves, and I hid in here to get out of sight. Damn bastard geologists and their magic ways! They musta seen me hide, cause next thing I knew, they locked the door and stuck me in here.

Teach them geologists a lesson! Oh... an' can ya get me some pieces of silk cloth for... for... nothin'.
narrative.objectives: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh, this is great! Nice feel to it too!

What? Oh, yeah... geologists. Got 'em good, did ya? I can't thank ya enough, adventurer. That'll give me some time to finish up in here... I mean, it'll let me not have to worry about them comin' back for me anytime soon. Thanks again.
narrative.requestItemsText: I ain't got all day! Get me those pieces of silk cloth! I mean geologists. Get those geologists! They deserve to feel my, well... your wrath.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 45 to 46, 8,950 XP in all.
